name: Station double-point indication interface
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Carries the defined two-contact equipment position through the station point mapping.
description: Carries the defined two-contact equipment position through the station point mapping. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Double-point device state” at the input and “Mapped station position” at the output. Intermediate and invalid states need preservation.
